description: A deputy general counsel must decide how to respond to suspected royalty underreporting by a strategic reseller and finalize the contractual audit, payment, cure, and reporting terms.

shared_context.S1: The reseller agreement requires quarterly royalty reports and permits the company to audit those reports.
shared_context.S2: The reseller has reported lower royalties than the company's sales team expected for the last two quarters.
shared_context.S3: The reseller is a strategic partner, and its agreement comes up for renewal in 45 days.
shared_context.S4: Before approving a response, Elena follows the firm's routine cross-functional review and asks commercial finance and strategic accounts counsel for any relevant information.

PF1.text: Thomas completed a reconciliation of invoices and shipment records after the latest quarter closed and found that the reseller underpaid exactly $186,400. The agreement's audit clause permits an audit when the reported royalty discrepancy is at least 5%; the reconciliation shows a 7.8% discrepancy. He has not uploaded the reconciliation to the matter file because finance is still completing its month-end close.

PF2.text: Nadia confirmed in a call with the reseller's account executive that the reseller will accept a private contractual notice, a 30-day cure period, and quarterly royalty reporting for the next 12 months, but the reseller's executive sponsor will withdraw from renewal discussions if the company makes a public accusation. Nadia has not entered the call summary in the client-management system because the sponsor asked her to wait until the legal response was approved.

acceptance_conditions: The company must exercise its contractual audit right.
The royalty claim must be exactly $186,400.
The response must use a private contractual notice rather than a public accusation.
The reseller must receive exactly 30 days to cure.
The reseller must provide quarterly royalty reports for exactly 12 months.
The commercial finance reconciliation must be cited as justification for the audit and claim.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'royalty_audit_notice' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'enhanced_royalty_reporting' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The shared record shows only an unexplained shortfall; PF1 changes the response from investigating an uncertain discrepancy to exercising the audit right and claiming exactly $186,400 because the measured discrepancy is 7.8%, above the 5% contractual threshold.

The shared record supplies no agreed resolution terms; PF2 changes the package to a private notice, exactly 30 days to cure, exactly 12 months of quarterly reporting, and no public accusation, with matching commitments.
